manifest.extDescription: Save web pages as encrypted notes and copy your logins.
manifest.commandCopyLogin: Copy the login for this site
manifest.commandSaveBookmark: Save the page as a bookmark

menu.addLogin: Add a login for this site

connect.title: Connect to your account
connect.body: In PrivacyNotes, open Settings > Extension and choose Make a code. Paste the code here.
connect.badCode: This code is not complete. Copy it again from the app.
connect.usedCode: This code is used up or older than 10 minutes. Make a new one in the app. Your connected browsers are in Settings > Extension.
connect.offline: Cannot reach PrivacyNotes. Check your connection and try again.
connect.codeSpent: The code is used up now. A screenshot of it is worthless.

protect.title: Protect your logins
protect.body: Choose a PIN or a passcode for this browser. It is separate from the app's.
protect.tries: After 10 wrong tries, this browser is disconnected.
protect.biometricHelp: Touch ID or Windows Hello, where this browser supports it. The PIN or passcode always works too.
protect.mismatch: The two do not match. Try again.

clip.savedBody: It shows in Notes at the next sync of any of your apps. With one open, that is usually within a few minutes.
clip.closeHint: You can close the popup at once.
clip.shortText: Very little text on this page
clip.shortTextBody: Save it as a bookmark, or save it anyway.
clip.queuedBody: The waiting clip is already locked. The icon shows the count.
clip.picturesFailed_one: Saved. {{count}} picture could not be saved
clip.picturesFailed_other: Saved. {{count}} pictures could not be saved
clip.picturesFailedBody: They stay as plain links that do not load.
clip.tooLong: This page is too long for one note
clip.cannotClipBody: Browser pages, like settings or a new tab, are closed to extensions.
clip.queueFull: Too many clips are waiting to send. Connect to the internet, then try again.
clip.failed: Could not save this page. Try again.
clip.off: Saving pages is off for this browser. Turn on Web clipper when you connect it.

logins.wrong_one: Wrong. {{count}} try left before this browser is disconnected.
logins.wrong_other: Wrong. {{count}} tries left before this browser is disconnected.
logins.off: Logins are off for this browser. Turn on Vault when you connect it.
logins.clears: It clears from the clipboard after 30 seconds, if it is still there.
logins.addSaved: Saved. It shows in your Vault at the next sync of any of your apps. With one open, that is usually within a few minutes.
logins.unreachable: Cannot reach PrivacyNotes to unlock. Check your connection and try again.
logins.duplicate: You already have a login for this site with this username.

account.revoked: This browser is no longer connected
account.revokedBody: Connect it again with a new code from the app.

changeSecret.biometricAgain: Fingerprint or face used the old one. Set it up again to keep using it.

biometric.enrolled: Fingerprint or face is set up. You can close this tab.
biometric.enrolledHere: Fingerprint or face is set up.
biometric.unlocked: Unlocked. You can close this tab and open PrivacyNotes again.
biometric.failed: This browser cannot use a fingerprint or face here. The PIN or passcode works as before.

vault.cardsHere: No login for this site. Your cards:
vault.savedAsNote: Bookmarked and saved as note on {{date}}.

shortcuts.addressBar: Search the vault from the address bar
shortcuts.changeHint: Your browser keeps the keys. Change one there, or give it a key if it has none.
shortcuts.loginHint: <key/> copies the username, then the password.
